digest.component_or_area: backend port / core module vendor decoupling
propositions: Core backend-neutral modules load Jira-specific rich-text and comment-limit modules by literal lazy-key, causing vendor code execution on any backend config
Jira ADF-encoded comments and truncation limits are unconditionally applied to outbound comment-diff and inbound normalization paths regardless of configured backend

Two literal lazy-load keys must be deleted from outbound_comments.py and one from inbound_translate.py by routing through backend port roles (FieldSanitizer.fit_comment and InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text)

FieldSanitizer gains fit_comment method delegating to comment_limits.truncate_comment_body without send-side warnings; InboundMapper gains normalize_rich_text method decoding ADF to text as backend-neutral defense
A sweep gate in test_backend_neutrality.py must verify no package-root core module contains the literal string 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira' except the recorded inbound_fields.py exemption

Public re-export _normalize_adf_body in inbound_translate.py must stay and route through the backend port; applier.py must drop three dead re-exports (_ADF_KEY_APPLIER, _AdfModule_Applier, _load_adf_module)
